organization.discoveryNotes: Construction operating model: multi-project sites, HSE and quality, procurement and materials receiving readiness, document control, cost/variation approvals, and advisory CyberCrow evidence posture (staging validated — not a customer claim).

workflows.name: Project kickoff
workflows.description: Charter, baseline schedule, and mobilization checklist before site work.

workflows.name: Site mobilization
workflows.description: Crews, access, and site readiness before daily operations.

workflows.name: Material request
workflows.description: Site raises material need; PM and materials review before procurement.

workflows.name: Purchase request
workflows.description: Procurement raises purchase; finance and PM approve per contract limits.

workflows.name: Supplier approval
workflows.description: New subcontractor or supplier vetted before PO or award.

workflows.name: Material receiving
workflows.description: Goods received on site with GRN and stock update readiness.

workflows.name: Site task assignment
workflows.description: Daily work packages assigned to site crews with status tracking.

workflows.name: Daily site report
workflows.description: Progress, manpower, and constraints logged for PM review.

workflows.name: HSE incident report
workflows.description: Incidents logged with corrective actions and evidence trail.

workflows.name: Quality inspection
workflows.description: Inspections, findings, and sign-off before handover stages.

workflows.name: Variation / change request
workflows.description: Scope or cost change with technical and commercial review.

workflows.name: Document submission / approval
workflows.description: Submittals routed through document control and PM.

workflows.name: Cost review
workflows.description: Budget vs actual reviewed with finance and PM.

workflows.name: Workforce request
workflows.description: HR coordinates crew changes and onboarding for site needs.

workflows.name: Monthly project performance review
workflows.description: KPIs, HSE, quality, and cost posture reviewed monthly.

workflows.name: Access / role review
workflows.description: Periodic review of site, vendor, and privileged roles.

securityRequirements.requirement: MFA for PM, procurement, finance approvers, and tenant admin
Contractor and vendor access time-bound to project
Audit trail on purchase, receiving, HSE, and variation records
Advisory NCA ECC alignment notes for identity and privileged access (readiness only)

integrations.notes: Corporate SSO for HQ and site leadership (readiness)
Future ERP readiness for projects, procurement, and finance — not live in this phase
Future PMIS readiness for drawings and RFIs — not live in this phase

experienceRequirements.requirement: Portfolio dashboard: active projects, HSE open items, cost posture
PM / site control view with workflows, tasks, and approval queue
Mobile-first site tasks, inspections, material and PO status
Project reporting and operating model readiness trends
CyberCrow console for site access, incidents, and evidence gaps

identity.ssoNotes: Construction template: Entra ID for HQ; MFA for approvers and site managers with financial authority (advisory policy).

security.complianceNotes: Separate contractor identities from employee roles; log HSE, procurement, and document events for evidence readiness — not certification claims.
